caseStudies.title: AWS ECS CI/CD Delivery Platform
caseStudies.challenge: Create a secure and repeatable deployment pathway from source control to production runtime.
approach: Implemented GitHub Actions pipeline for build, push, and deploy
Used OIDC role assumption instead of static cloud credentials
Integrated ECS task definition rendering for immutable image rollout
Added health checks and wait-for-stability deployment gates
caseStudies.outcome: Production deployments run from main branch with traceable image versions and service health validation.

caseStudies.title: Stable Public Endpoint Architecture
caseStudies.challenge: Replace ephemeral task IP access with a stable and reliable URL.
approach: Provisioned Application Load Balancer and target group
Configured routing to ECS service tasks on container port
Applied security group rules for ALB-to-service communication
Validated health endpoint and production traffic flow
caseStudies.outcome: Service exposed through a stable ALB endpoint suitable for portfolio and production demonstrations.

certifications: Cloud architecture and delivery best-practice orientation
Production deployment and operations troubleshooting experience
